intro: Dedicated to providing clear, practical legal support for planning ahead, protecting your loved ones, and safeguarding what you have built.
biographyIntro: Amber C. Green is the founder of AC Law Firm. Her journey to becoming an attorney is one rooted in ambition, perseverance, and a willingness to take a risk on the future she envisioned for herself.

sections.title: Education & Early Career
paragraphs: Originally from the Bronx, New York, Amber began her college journey at Borough of Manhattan Community College before transferring to the University at Albany. With a natural curiosity about people, relationships, and human behavior, she pursued a degree in Sociology with a minor in Psychology, graduating magna cum laude.

After college, Amber began her career in the New York State Assembly, where she worked as a Legislative Assistant and gained an inside look at the legislative process and the role law and public policy play in people's everyday lives. She eventually transitioned from government work to the legal field, where she worked as a paralegal. While working alongside attorneys, Amber simultaneously worked toward her goal of becoming an attorney.

sections.title: Law School & Beyond
paragraphs: Pursuing that goal required Amber to make one of the biggest decisions of her life: leaving New York and moving to Miami, Florida, to attend law school. She earned her Juris Doctor from Florida International University College of Law, where her experiences extended beyond the classroom to research, leadership, mentorship, and service.

After law school, Amber's journey brought her to Washington, D.C., where she continued developing as an attorney. Her experiences in practice eventually led her to Maryland where she began working as an estates and trusts attorney. She quickly realized that this area of law brought together many of the things that shaped her as a professional—it combined the importance of relationships, thoughtful decision-making, advocacy, and helping people navigate significant transitions in their lives.

sections.title: Founding AC Law Firm
paragraphs: Amber gained a clear vision for the kind of attorney she wanted to be and the type of client experience she wanted to provide. That vision ultimately led her to found AC Law Firm, a practice built around thoughtful counsel, personal attention, and the belief that clients should understand not only their legal options, but how those options affect their families and their futures.
